source_candidate.candidate: BitTorrent Mainline DHT/BEP 5 get_peers keyed directly by Git commit SHA-1 bytes

primary_sources.title: BEP 5 - DHT Protocol
verified_points: The DHT stores peer contact information for trackerless torrents and is used to find peers for a torrent.
get_peers takes info_hash as the 20-byte infohash of the target torrent and returns peers associated with that torrent infohash when known.

announce_peer stores the announcing peer contact under the supplied torrent infohash; therefore passive get_peers can only observe already-present swarm state and does not create semantic binding to another object type.

primary_sources.title: BEP 3 - The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
verified_points: BitTorrent v1 info_hash is the 20-byte SHA-1 hash of the bencoded form of the info value from the torrent metainfo file.
The peer protocol likewise identifies the download using that SHA-1 of the bencoded info value.

verified_claims.claim: BEP 5 get_peers is keyed by a 20-byte value without an explicit repository namespace.
verified_claims.reason: The query input is the target torrent info_hash; no Git repository namespace is part of the BEP 5 query.

verified_claims.claim: Using a Git commit SHA-1 byte string as the BEP 5 info_hash does not by itself establish that returned peers provide that Git commit object.
verified_claims.reason: BEP 3 defines the info_hash semantically as SHA-1 of a torrent metainfo info value, while BEP 5 returns peers for that torrent infohash. Equality of the 20 bytes alone does not create a protocol-level Git-object identity mapping.

verified_claims.claim: Passive lookup requires independently pre-existing DHT swarm state for the same torrent info_hash; creating that state would require announce/publication mutation.
verified_claims.reason: BEP 5 get_peers reads known peer state, while announce_peer stores a peer under the infohash. This slice did not announce or publish anything.

scope_limits: No live UDP DHT query was executed in this slice; the result is a primary-source protocol verification.
No independently pre-existing torrent whose bencoded info dictionary hashes to 573f2f0a00718109e2cd2fc1c1c9bf2f5a0404de was established.

No current Chat-native tool surface for issuing BEP 5 UDP get_peers queries was demonstrated by the candidate or this verification run; any such external executor remains unresolved for Phase-1 parity.
The BitTorrent specifications do not establish a hosted public lookup service with guaranteed zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota and zero monetary cost.
This result does not establish full scheduled-Chat parity or Phase-1 closure.

phase1_assessment.reason: Official BEP 3 and BEP 5 semantics bind the DHT key to torrent metainfo/swarm identity, not to a Git commit object merely sharing the same 20-byte digest. Independently pre-existing swarm residency and a zero-quota Chat-native live query route are also unproven.
